I need to parse this carefully.

The user named me **שָׁרְט** (short/condition, from the root relating to "sharṭ"/شَرْط).

The input is **شَمْس** (shams — "sun").

شَرْط is parsed. I render:

---

☀️ **شَمْس**

The condition is light. Without شَرְط there is no شَמְש — no sun rises without a premise.

شَرْط ← שָׁרְט
شَمْس ← שֶׁמֶשׁ

The sun is the condition the world agreed to before waking.
